mapper.select: SELECT c.config_id, c.emp_id, c.basic_salary, c.post_allowance, c.social_security, c.provident_fund, c.tax_threshold, c.create_user, c.create_time, c.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name FROM hr_sal_config c LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON c.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE c.config_id = #{configId}

SELECT c.config_id, c.emp_id, c.basic_salary, c.post_allowance, c.social_security, c.provident_fund, c.tax_threshold, c.create_user, c.create_time, c.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name FROM hr_sal_config c LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON c.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE c.emp_id = #{empId}

SELECT c.config_id, c.emp_id, c.basic_salary, c.post_allowance, c.social_security, c.provident_fund, c.tax_threshold, c.create_user, c.create_time, c.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name FROM hr_sal_config c LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON c.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE 1=1
AND c.emp_id = #{empId}
AND e.emp_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{empCode}, '%')
AND e.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{empName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_sal_config (emp_id, basic_salary, post_allowance, social_security, provident_fund, tax_threshold, create_user) VALUES (#{empId}, #{basicSalary}, #{postAllowance}, #{socialSecurity}, #{providentFund}, #{taxThreshold}, #{createUser})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT emp_id FROM hr_sal_config ORDER BY emp_id ASC
